issues.title: Weak starter or intermittent electrical supply: inspect battery/gearbox/chassis ground paths
issues.cause: The factory uses parallel battery-ground paths to G25 and G2 and a redundant gearbox-to-body lead; damage, resistance or disconnection is a possible diagnostic hypothesis, not a documented incidence.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Identify G2 and G25 on the actual vehicle and perform condition, connection, cranking-voltage and voltage-drop checks under a separately verified electrical procedure; distinguish battery, starter, generator and ignition feeds.
issues.correction_summary: Repair only demonstrated cable/terminal/circuit defects using an applicable factory procedure and verified component specifications.
limits: Symptoms and electrical fault hypotheses are general diagnostic framing, not a known failure rate or a guaranteed cause.
Do not short, bypass, modify or load-test unfused conductors without safe equipment and verified service steps.
No cable part-number fitment, tightening torque, corrosion threshold or battery replacement decision is certified.

issues.title: Petrol cooling fan does not run at commanded speed: identify relays and shared grounds
issues.cause: The wiring documentation identifies two fan motors, relays 81/155/396, control module DICE and G30/G40/G42 returns as diagnostic circuit elements; it does not say which one has failed.
symptoms: fan fails to start when control demands operation
issues.diagnosis_summary: Determine A/C and fan configuration, read coolant-temperature data, inspect relay/fuse/ground/motor supply paths and DICE commands against the exact model-year wiring diagram; preserve normal afterrun behavior.
issues.correction_summary: Resolve a measured sensor, control, harness, relay or fan-motor defect with the correct factory procedure rather than modifying fan temperature thresholds.
limits: Component list is not a complete color/pin continuity reconstruction.
The two-fan drawing must not be imposed on a car without the necessary A/C equipment.
No replacement relay, harness or fan interchange is approved by this record.

gaps.title: T7 2007–09 complete graphical electrical schematics and ECU pin continuity
missing_inputs: Extract and individually corroborate all four wiring-diagram sheets for each year; map connector pin positions, wire colors/gauges, fuses, ground returns, splices and ECU terminals, separately for LHD/RHD and markets.
gaps.reason: Readable component locators do not expose every physical circuit and cannot authorize probing or replacement.

gaps.title: Fuse-by-fuse and option-specific current distribution
missing_inputs: Retrieve original fuse board assignment charts and fuse ratings for MY2007, 2008 and 2009 with A/C, body, LHD/RHD, engine and transmission boundaries.
gaps.reason: Named distribution boards are not per-circuit electrical allocation or safe replacement fuse ratings.

gaps.title: Battery ground replacement identifiers and measurable acceptance
missing_inputs: Find Saab OE cable/eyelet identifiers, original torque, protective finish, safe inspection points, factory voltage-drop test ranges, and whether later harness revisions exist.
gaps.reason: Factory 25/16/10 mm2 sizes are not a complete parts specification or evidence of wire condition.

gaps.title: Cooling fan connector pinouts and equipment variants

gaps.reason: Component lists show circuit participants and ground locations only, not safe test leads or every car's fan count.
